scope: Completed CPU-only expansion cases 12 and 13; both excluded from validated evaluation

reviewed_cases.visual_observation: The lung field contains densely packed dark H&E nuclei, while virtual DAPI is broadly pale with many dark nuclear centers. The map does not reliably localize to the outlined nuclei; AUC 0.684 and boundary contrast 0.017 fail. A horizontal tissue gap appears in H&E and multiple marker previews, so it is not identified as a stitching shadow from this contact sheet alone.

The kidney field contains large cells with heterogeneous staining. Virtual DAPI highlights only some visible nuclei and is bright in several broad cell-sized areas; the outlined objects are not consistently aligned. AUC 0.538 and boundary contrast 0.007 fail.

limits: This is review of display-scaled, verified-identity previews. It does not rescue failed cases or establish biological accuracy for the other predicted proteins.
